say:1:1230413001:1.text: Sinbad told us about you when he last came back. He said he met some new friends who had drifted in with the waves.
say:1:1230413001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达自己说的，他上次回村子的时候，和我们说认识了几个...
say:1:1230413001:1.male: Sinbad told us about you when he last came back. He said he met some new friends who had drifted in with the waves.
say:1:1230413001:1.female: Sinbad told us about you when he last came back. He said he met some new friends who had drifted in with the waves.

say:2:1230413002:1.text: He's a big boy now and rarely tells us things about himself. All we know is that he has connections in Rustport and is involved in serious business—we don't know the details.
say:2:1230413002:1.source_cn: 自从他长大之后，就很少和我们聊他自己的事情。我们只知道...
say:2:1230413002:1.male: He's a big boy now and rarely tells us things about himself. All we know is that he has connections in Rustport and is involved in serious business—we don't know the details.
say:2:1230413002:1.female: He's a big boy now and rarely tells us things about himself. All we know is that he has connections in Rustport and is involved in serious business—we don't know the details.

say:3:1230413003:1.text: He's always aspired to become a captain and a hero, just like his father.
say:3:1230413003:1.source_cn: 他一直想像他爹那样，成为船长，了不起的英雄。
say:3:1230413003:1.male: He's always aspired to become a captain and a hero, just like his father.
say:3:1230413003:1.female: He's always aspired to become a captain and a hero, just like his father.

say:4:1230413004:1.text: But as his elders, we're happy as long as he's safe.
say:4:1230413004:1.source_cn: 可对我们这些长辈来说，能看到他平安成长，就已经足够了。
say:4:1230413004:1.male: But as his elders, we're happy as long as he's safe.
say:4:1230413004:1.female: But as his elders, we're happy as long as he's safe.
